Container.Name: OppaiLib-Trainer
Container.Overview: The LoRA trainer for OppaiLib. OppaiLib's Create → Train screen sends it pictures from your library, captioned from their tags, and it trains a LoRA for an SD 1.5 or SDXL (Pony, Illustrious, NoobAI) checkpoint with kohya's sd-scripts; OppaiLib then installs the result into Automatic1111 or InvokeAI by itself. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (the Nvidia Driver plugin) — 12 GB or more for SDXL, or Low VRAM mode below that. Pictures are deleted from here the moment their run ends.
Container.Description: LoRA trainer for OppaiLib. Set a token, then put this container's address and the token under OppaiLib → Settings → Image generation → LoRA training.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: The trainer's API. Only OppaiLib (and InvokeAI, which fetches finished LoRAs from it) needs to reach it.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Runs in progress, finished LoRAs waiting to be installed, and a cache of the few checkpoints OppaiLib has sent. A checkpoint is several GB, so put this on a pool with room.

Config.Name: Generator's models folder (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, read-only. The same models folder Automatic1111 or InvokeAI loads checkpoints from — the one OppaiLib maps at /a1111-models. With it here, checkpoints are read in place; without it, OppaiLib sends the checkpoint over the network the first time it is trained against.

Config.Name: Token
Config.Description: Any long random string. OppaiLib must be given the same one. Without it, anyone who can reach the port can use the GPU.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: Which NVIDIA GPU to train on: all, or a GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin.

Config.Name: Checkpoints kept
Config.Description: How many checkpoints sent by OppaiLib are kept in /data for next time.
